name: PiWeb AI Tools with MCP for WooCommerce
author: PI Web Solution

sections.description:
PiWeb MCP Connector for WooCommerce extends the existing WooCommerce MCP toolset by adding additional structured tools that can be used inside MCP-enabled environments.

This plugin does not create a separate connection layer. Instead, it enhances the current WooCommerce MCP implementation by registering new tools that become available within the MCP service.

If your WooCommerce store already supports MCP, this plugin expands what AI agents and automation systems can do.

short_description: Adds additional MCP tools and WebMCP integration to WooCommerce website, extending the existing MCP toolset with advanced store capabilities.
